questions.question: The four phases of the business cycle, in order, are:
The peak is characterised by:
options: Activity at its fullest — capacity strained, jobs plentiful, prices pressing upward, skills short

questions.question: The seeds of recovery lie in the trough because:
options: Cycles run on a fixed timetable
Costs are low, interest rates typically eased, and replacement demand has accumulated

questions.question: The practical definition of a recession is:
options: TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS of declining real GDP

questions.question: Leading indicators move BEFORE the economy turns because:
options: They are decisions made today about TOMORROW'S activity — building plans, new orders, confidence

questions.question: Unemployment is a LAGGING indicator because:
options: Firms retrench late and rehire late — joblessness turns after the economy has

questions.question: The timing order examines as:
options: Leading WARNS, coincident CONFIRMS the present, lagging CERTIFIES the past

questions.question: In South Africa, the composite indicators are compiled and the cycle officially dated by:
options: The RESERVE BANK — announcing, after careful lag, when swings began and ended

questions.question: The four movements inside an economic time series are:
options: TREND, CYCLICAL, SEASONAL and IRREGULAR movements

questions.question: December's retail jump belongs to:
options: The SEASONAL movement — a regular within-year calendar pattern

questions.question: Statisticians publish seasonally adjusted figures so that:
options: The cycle underneath the calendar pattern can be seen

questions.question: A single flood month collapsing output is classified as:
options: An IRREGULAR movement — a one-off shock with no pattern

questions.question: Exogenous causes are:
options: Pushes originating OUTSIDE the economic system — drought, wars, pandemics, world commodity prices

questions.question: Waves of optimism feeding investment, and credit expanding then tightening, are examples of:
options: ENDOGENOUS causes — arising inside the system's own workings

questions.question: Real cycles typically involve:
options: An outside shock landing on an inside AMPLIFIER — both together

questions.question: In a downswing, government is squeezed because:
options: Tax revenue FALLS exactly when grant and support needs RISE

questions.question: "More customers means more hiring means more customers" describes:
options: Breathing IN — the upswing feeding on itself

questions.question: What quietly gathers at EMPTY (the trough)?
options: Cheap costs, easier borrowing, and replacement needs — the makings of the next turn upward

questions.question: The two street truths about the breath:
options: It repeats yearly and is announced in advance
It never repeats and never ends
It repeats but never on schedule — and a recession is officially two consecutive quarters of shrinking production

questions.question: Building plans passed are HEADLIGHTS because:
options: They are decisions about next year's activity — bending before the economy does

questions.question: This month's production and retail sales are:
options: The SPEEDOMETER — coincident indicators confirming where we are right now

questions.question: "When the mirror looks terrible, the worst may already be behind you" refers to:
options: LAGGING indicators like unemployment, which peak after the trough

questions.question: "The leading indicator declined for a third month" translates as:
options: The economy grew three months ago
The country's headlights are dimming — a turn may be coming even while today feels fine

subtopics.title: Why the Wave Comes — and Who Gets Wet

questions.question: South Africa's "special weather" among outside stones is:
options: WORLD COMMODITY PRICES — when platinum and coal prices fall abroad, mine towns feel it within months

questions.question: Mood as an economic force means:
options: Confidence spreads through investment and hiring until expectations overreach and snap — an inside push

questions.question: "Never everyone equally" — the downswing reaches:
options: The boardroom before the shop floor
The shop floor first — newest hired, least skilled, township before suburb

questions.question: Reading the cycle as self-defence means:
options: Expecting the trough to last forever
Paying down debt near the peak, patience near the trough — and never mistaking a season or a shock for the tide
